scientific_limits: FR queue and shared-credit allowance are coupled by actual Core formula; this is not isolated queue capacity.
Credit is an arbitration accounting allowance, not an extra physical buffer; do not add FR entries and credit counts into independent SRAM storage.
L2 data calculation excludes tag/sector status and other metadata. Nominal MSHR/miss queue capacities do not establish occupancy or actual hardware layout.
Host RSS and C++ queue/list/pointer size do not measure chip SRAM area or energy.
CH/DH L1 data, Tag, physical pool, PIB and timing differ; matching downstream settings does not imply equal area.
This file establishes configuration cost, not performance or a chosen optimal F profile.
